description: The Arch Android Toolkit is a comprehensive suite of utilities designed to streamline Android and Kotlin Multiplatform development. It provides high-level abstractions for state management (View & Scene State Machines), type-safe key-value storage, lifecycle-aware property delegates, and specialized support for foldable devices using Jetpack WindowManager. Built with a Kotlin-first approach, it focuses on developer ergonomics, clean architecture, and seamless KMP compatibility.
